---
name: legacy-code-discovery
description: Map an unfamiliar legacy repository, request flow, dependencies, and observed behaviour with confidence-labelled evidence.
---
# Legacy code discovery

1. Inventory solution/project files and entry points without changing code.
2. Map framework, routes, controllers, views, services, persistence, dependencies, and tests.
3. Follow one user request from UI through validation and persistence to response.
4. Locate business rules, duplicated validation, side effects, errors, and time-dependent logic.
5. Record each claim with path/line evidence and confidence; separate fact, inference, conflict, assumption, and SME question.
6. Populate the component-map and application-inventory templates.

Do not refactor or resolve ambiguous policy. Validate important findings against another source where possible, and report only commands actually run.
